title: Principal Product Manager (Banking / Fintech / Consulting)
description:
Thoughtworks partners with clients to build impactful digital products which deliver extraordinary customer experiences. We do this by integrating design, strategy and technology. We’re looking for a seasoned product leader, with experience in identifying, launching and scaling new products and product portfolio and with a background in Banking / Financial Services / Fintech and Consulting to join the Customer Experience, Product and Design (CXPD) service line.

Job responsibilities

  • As a trusted advisor to our client’s leadership, you will partner with them to understand their context and needs, make recommendations, and provide advice and hands-on expertise on taking new products from concept to market to scale.
  • Drive the innovation mindset and the overall product development lifecycle, utilising lean and hypothesis driven approaches to identify, conceptualise and pilot new products that deliver undeniable value. 
  • Establish the market & competitive landscape, go to market strategy and business case or economic model for the opportunity with our clients. 
  • Lead the stakeholders to think about customer’s problems, business outcomes and take them on the change journey of moving to empowered product teams that create strategic growth for the organisation.
  • Shape and lead teams to deliver client engagements in a way which is both effective for our client and operationally sound for Thoughtworks.
  • Help shape CXPD service line value propositions, creating case studies, points of view and other content through insights on client needs and solutions, and also through defining repeatable practices which will help us to scale our efforts.

title: Account Executive, Bridge
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Account Management team at Bridge is dedicated to the growth, retention, and expansion of key customers. Our Enterprise Account Management team focuses on driving measurable expansion across a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers through deep account knowledge, flawless technical execution and strong cross-functional partnership. 

Why Bridge

Join a team that values clear thinking, quantitative rigor, and customer obsession. At Bridge you’ll own meaningful customer outcomes, operate with autonomy, and have the opportunity to shape how we scale revenue across high-potential accounts.

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Account Manager at Bridge you will own a book of existing Enterprise and Strategic accounts and be responsible for deepening relationships, expanding revenue, identifying product gaps and driving product adoption, preventing churn and securing long-term renewals. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals. title: Product Manager – US B2C Experience (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The US market is Raisin’s fastest-growing region, where our deposit marketplace connects customers with banks to help both achieve better financial outcomes. As a Product Manager within the US Tribe, you’ll play a key role in scaling our growth engine and enhancing the end-to-end customer experience.

You’ll be part of a cross-functional product team, reporting to the Head of Product, US, and collaborating closely with leaders across Marketing, Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Service. Partnering with our EU-based engineering team, you’ll drive initiatives that strengthen our product foundations, adopt industry best practices, and deliver a best-in-class B2C experience for US customers.

title: Staff Software Engineer, GenAI Enablement Squad, Foundations Alliance
description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

You'll work with HelloFresh's GenAI Enablement Squad, a cross-functional team helping teams across the company unlock the practical value of AI. The mission is simple: identify high-impact problems, build AI-powered solutions that solve them, and scale what works. As a Staff Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering, product, and business. One week you might be embedded with the HR or Finance teams understanding how they work; the next you'll be building an agentic workflow, integrating it into the internal tooling, or scaling a successful prototype into a production system used across the company.

title: Staff Product Manager, Organic Growth
description:
The Opportunity 

 

HelloFresh is the world's leading meal-kit company, serving millions of subscribers across 18 markets. Historically, we have grown through paid acquisition, but the way people discover food is changing twice over. Search is being reshaped by AI, and a new generation of consumers is asking ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity to "plan dinner for my family this week" instead of opening an app or a search engine. Whoever shows up in those answers wins the category-default position. Whoever does not is invisible.

We own the meal-kit category in organic search and in LLMs. The broader food and recipe universe, where 150M+ monthly searches live, is still dominated by publishers with decades of content authority. Closing that gap is one of the largest, most durable growth opportunities in the business, and it is the mandate of the Organic Growth squad.

We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead Organic Growth and level it up from a traditional SEO function into a modern organic discovery engine spanning SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and an emerging Agentic Commerce mandate. This is the single-threaded leadership role for how HelloFresh and Factor get discovered, cited, and chosen across Google and AI surfaces.

 

The role 

 

You will own the end-to-end product strategy for organic discovery technical SEO, content infrastructure at scale, GEO and AI visibility, and the early Agentic Commerce surface that turns discovery into action inside LLMs. You'll inherit a real foundation: a quality-first content strategy, recipe-collection automation, a GEO editorial framework, and a shipped Discovery MCP / ChatGPT App proof-of-concept.
